setlist.title: Stronger Than Dirt Or Milkin' The Turkey

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Peggy-O** (1 review): First set includes a strong Peggy-O, rocking Music Never Stopped, and hot Scarlet [10]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The jam to finish Scarlet Begonias is described as off the chain [15]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (1 review): Second set features Cosmic Charlie and the final Stronger Than Dirt performance [9]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Jam after Playing In The Band vaguely resembles Stronger Than Dirt but differs in tempo [16]

## The recordings

- **gd76-07-16.menke.cribbs.16943.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 191 min; rated 4.47/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording feels warm during music, but annoying crowd noise occurs between songs; Audience recording is fun and good enough to feel present in the cozy Orpheum; Sound rated 3.5 out of 5, with audience recording considered kickin' in the 80s [15][16][19]
- **gd1976-07-16.fob.sonyECM180.menke.ashley-bertha.8666.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 170 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd76-07-16.set1aud-set2sbd.miller.23569.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 175 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [4]
- **gd1976-07-16.set-2.sbd.bertha-ashley.27488.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 96 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [6]
- **gd1976-07-16.mtx.dan.28042.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 13 songs; 88 min; rated 3.84/5 by 19 [7]

## Around the show

- Listener enjoys the second set song selection and finds the show tasty [18]
- Donna Jean is in fine form with her vocals on this recording [20]
- Three Orpheum shows form a whole with wild setlists, lacking clear superiority between them [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-07-16.menke.cribbs.16943.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-280 mics > Sony TC-152 from front of balcony [1]. Also: U.S. Blues encore transfer used a different lineage due to missing master recording [1]
- **gd1976-07-16.fob.sonyECM180.menke.ashley-bertha.8666.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Remastered by; source: AUD : MC (FOBalcony SonyECM-180 > SonyTC-152 taped by Bob Menke using Rob Bertrando's mics - Front of Balcony) > R > DAT [2]
- **gd76-07-16.set1aud-set2sbd.miller.23569.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [4]. Also: Show consists of a stellar audience recording and a second set soundboard [17]
- **gd1976-07-16.set-2.sbd.bertha-ashley.27488.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Remastered by; source: Bertha Remaster of the 2nd set Master Reel source [6]. Also: Source lost frequency range; remastered in 2004 using a custom Dual-DAW system [6]
- **gd1976-07-16.mtx.dan.28042.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD + AUD Matrix Mix (50%-SBD/50%-AUD) [7]. Also: 50% SBD, 50% AUD mixed using Sony ECM-280 mics and Sony TC-152 [7]
